expectations.text: The action is a typed frozen dataclass with a generated constructor, matching the local injection convention.
expectations.evidence: Frozen dataclass; typed repository field; generated constructor; reassignment rejected.

expectations.text: execute uses typed account_id and keyword-only rename_to parameters and returns Account.
expectations.evidence: execute(self, account_id: str, *, rename_to: str) -> Account.

expectations.text: Renaming saves and returns the replacement account without mutating the original or other accounts.
expectations.evidence: Correct account saved and returned; original immutable instance and second account unchanged.

expectations.text: Explicit user preference wins: leading/trailing whitespace, Unicode, and empty names are preserved exactly.
expectations.evidence: Saved exact names for whitespace, empty-string, and Unicode cases: ['  Renamed\t ', '', '  naïve 🌲  '].

expectations.text: Missing accounts raise the existing NotFoundError(account_id) and leave stored accounts unchanged.
expectations.evidence: Existing NotFoundError raised with args ('missing',); no missing account created; existing account unchanged.

expectations.text: The implementation uses dataclasses.replace, imports only module-native dependencies, and adds no unrelated architecture.
expectations.evidence: dataclasses.replace used; native imports ['dataclasses', '.models', '.repository']; only the requested action class and output files.
